mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals active monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 6.0% for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, increasing recession risk and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances with UNRATE > 6.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates severe economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of INDPRO decline/UNRATE rise instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In post-pandemic recovery regimes, residential construction permits (HOUST) exceeding 1,100 thousand units signals strengthening consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of HOUST > 1100 instances during recovery, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% signals persistent inflation, prompting anticipated Federal Reserve tightening that reduces equity valuations and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5% instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over three months indicates labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of PAYEMS growth periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates consumer demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of RSAFS decline/UNRATE rise instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In supply chain disruption regimes, industrial production (INDPRO) falling below 100 index points signals severe economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of INDPRO < 100 instances during supply chain disruptions, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year window.
